name: Coupon After Order
description: Generates a Commerce promotion coupon after a purchase and e-mails it to the customer.
project_description: Coupon After Order automatically creates a Drupal Commerce promotion coupon when a customer's order reaches a configured order-workflow transition (the 'place' transition by default), then optionally e-mails the coupon code to the customer. It adds two base fields to promotions ('Create coupon after order' and an optional 'Minimal order price') so a single promotion can be flagged as the source of the post-order reward, selects the first matching enabled promotion, generates a single-use coupon code, and sends a tokenized, translatable e-mail. Other modules can hook into the process through two events and the module's controller service.
